integrity.finite_checks: Directly enumerated all candidate edge deletions and 2/3-vertex total dominating sets on 14 small part-size pairs; checked explicit constructions and pair-cover instances.
integrity.proof_type: self-contained combinatorial argument plus independent finite adjacency enumeration
integrity.unproved_limits: No independent audit, no priority guarantee, no general k-bondage claim.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns 2-total bondage of complete bipartite graphs only; it does not solve the \(k\ge3\) problem or arbitrary bipartite graphs.
The cut count is for labelled edges, not isomorphism orbits.
The full text of the 2026 journal edition could not be accessed; the complete 2025 arXiv preprint was examined, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact two-total bondage and extremal deletion cuts in complete bipartite graphs
